summary: The authority system constrains model output, not hostile same-UID processes. Authority tables need no tamper-evidence against that excluded adversary. Git-derived scope, cross_scope capability, manifest-digest pinning, typed refusals and principal_ref remain load-bearing. A process boundary would require a separate UID and a UID-checked socket, which CD-0003 and CD-0042 foreclose. Client revocation and key rotation remain reachable; per-grant revocation is not required.
title: The authority boundary is the model's output, not the agent's process
